newsitem.title: UK: GIIT plans to change capital structure.
newsitem.headline: GIIT plans to change capital structure.

text.p: Geared Income Investment Trust Plc (GIIT) wants to reorganise its capital structure by issuing new income shares and amending the rights of existing ordinary shares, the company's adviser Hoare Govett said on Wednesday.
Under the proposals, each GIIT shareholder will receive one income share for every existing ordinary shareheld on the record date of March 14.
Once the reorganisation takes effect, shareholders will have one ordinary and one income share for each ordinary share currently held.
The two classes of share will trade separately and provide shareholders with greater flexibility, Hoare Govett said in a statement.
The proposals will be put to an extraordinary general meeting on March 21.

"In its review, the board's intention has been to maintain at least the present level of dividends while seeking to improve the prospects for capital appreciation of the company portfolio," Hoare Govett said.
The income shares will convert after about 6-1/2 years into ordinary shares by reference to the net asset value to each class of share at the time of conversion.
